daily.title: Daily project expense report
daily.description: One row per employee per day per project ID. Approved expenses only. Rows missing project ID or name are highlighted for review.
daily.reviewHint: Highlighted rows are missing project ID or project name on the underlying expense(s). Both fields are required — fix the expense or check Settings field mappings.
daily.clickRowHint: Click any row to see the approved expenses that make up that line.
daily.sourceSheetDescription: Approved expenses grouped into this report row.
daily.sourceNoExpenses: No source expenses found for this row.
daily.sourceOpenExpenseHint: Use the eye icon to open the full expense detail page.
daily.noRows: No approved expenses in this period for the selected filters.
daily.configRequiredHint: Configure project fields and category mappings in Settings before generating this report.

errors.generic: The report could not be completed. No partial report was generated.
errors.page_failed: The report could not be completed because one data page failed to load. No partial report was generated.
errors.incomplete: The report could not be completed because some rows were missing. No partial report was generated.
errors.duplicate_row: The report could not be completed because a row was returned twice. No partial report was generated.
errors.snapshot_changed: The data changed while the report was being prepared. Please run the report again.
errors.cancelled: Report generation was cancelled. No report was generated.
errors.malformed_response: The report could not be completed because the server sent an unexpected response.
errors.malformed_cursor: The report could not be completed because the server sent an unexpected response.
errors.missing_cursor: The report could not be completed because the server sent an unexpected response.
errors.missing_total: The report could not be completed because the server did not report how many rows to expect.
errors.schema_version_mismatch: This app version cannot read the report format returned by the server. Please reload the page.
errors.too_many_pages: The report could not be completed because it exceeded the maximum size.

liveRefresh.initialLoadingHint: Fetching live expenses for the selected filters.
liveRefresh.refreshingHint: Showing the last loaded report while the latest expenses are fetched.
liveRefresh.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the live report.
liveRefresh.showingCached: Showing the last successfully loaded report.
liveRefresh.exportWait: Wait for the live report refresh to finish before exporting.
